Interface GenerationListener

public interface GenerationListener
Callback for autoregressive generation progress on a single request.

Serve and other clients implement this (or compose helpers) instead of passing a SubmissionPublisher into the model. A streaming adapter can forward onText(String) to a publisher; a metrics sink can override only the counters it cares about. When many requests run concurrently, the InferenceEngine binds one listener per request.

Typical order for one request:

  1. onInputTokens(int) / onCachedInputTokens(int) once after prompt bind
  2. repeated onGeneratedTokens(int) (and optional onText(String))
  3. onThinkingTokens(int) when the engine can attribute “thinking” tokens (not emitted yet)

  • Method Details

    • onInputTokens

      default void onInputTokens(int count)
      Reports the number of prompt / input tokens.
      Parameters:
      count - prompt token count; >= 0.

    • onCachedInputTokens

      default void onCachedInputTokens(int count)
      Reports how many input tokens were served from the KV prefix cache (radix hit), so they need not be recomputed in prefill.

      Always <= the value passed to onInputTokens(int). When prefix reuse is disabled or there is no match, count is 0.

      Parameters:
      count - cached input token count; >= 0.

    • onGeneratedTokens

      default void onGeneratedTokens(int count)
      Reports newly generated completion tokens (not prompt tokens).
      Parameters:
      count - number of tokens produced since the previous call; typically 1.

    • onThinkingTokens

      default void onThinkingTokens(int count)
      Reports tokens attributed to a model “thinking” / reasoning span (e.g. Qwen thinking mode), distinct from final answer tokens.

      Reserved: the engine does not emit this yet. Implementations may override it for forward compatibility; the default is a no-op.

      Parameters:
      count - thinking tokens since the previous call; >= 0.

    • onText

      default void onText(String chunk)
      Reports a decoded UTF-8 text chunk suitable for streaming to a client.

      May be called less often than onGeneratedTokens(int) (implementations commonly coalesce ~20 tokens, or flush on EOS). Empty strings are not delivered.

      Parameters:
      chunk - decoded text (special tokens already skipped when applicable).
